/**
   * Return the child folder which the specified name.
   *
   * @param name - The name of the child folder to find
   * @return The child folder, or null if the folder with 'name' does not exist.
   */
  nsIMsgFolder getChildNamed(in AUTF8String name);
"should get null Trash1 child when not found"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current GetChildNamed sets its output to nullptr and returns success when no child matches. It still rejects an empty name or missing output pointer. The compose helper can therefore use lookup || createLocalSubfolder for Drafts. Keep absence, invalid input and folder creation distinct when converting an old exception-based caller. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Return null for a missing legacy child without treating invalid input as missing
